tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List Premrest commercial flooring services, including non-slip coatings, anti-slip tile treatments, slippery-floor assessments, flood restoration, and phone and SMS contact details. Prices and availability require assessment by the Premrest team.

tools.name: submit_service_request
tools.description: Creates a Premrest quote, preferred-date booking or flood restoration enquiry in the private staff queue and sends it to the website Formspree inbox with the configured AI integration source. Submitting an enquiry requests contact from Premrest about that enquiry. urgent_flood requests use flood-res

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_services" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List Premrest commercial flooring services, including non-slip coatings, anti-slip tile treatments and slippery-floor assessments. Prices and availability require assessment by the Premrest team."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
